description: A horizontal strip of vertical lists where selecting a node reveals its children in the next column — the macOS Finder column view, with drag/keyboard-resizable columns and an optional preview pane.

props.name: children
props.description:
The strip's tree, authored recursively: root
{@link MillerColumnsColumnPropsColumn(s)} whose branch
{@link MillerColumnsItemPropsItems} nest further Columns, plus an
optional trailing {@link MillerColumnsPreviewPanelPropsPreviewPanel}.
There is no `items` data prop — the JSX *is* the data.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
Initial selection path on first render, root column first (e.g.
`["docs", "guides"]`). The component owns the path thereafter.
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `value` instead.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Reading direction. Under `"rtl"` the horizontal arrow pair is
mirrored — ArrowLeft steps *into* a branch's child column and
ArrowRight walks back out — so navigation follows the visual order.
Inherited from a `DirectionProvider` ancestor when omitted.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — pass `value` + `onValueChange` to
control the component.
Called with the new selection path whenever the selection changes.
Required in controlled mode.

props.name: value
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultValue` instead.
The controlled selection path, root column first. Must be kept in sync
by the parent via `onValueChange`.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Row and column size for the whole strip; `data-density` scales each size further.

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-strip
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-slot
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

props.name: children
props.description:
The column's {@link MillerColumnsItemPropsItems} and, optionally, a
{@link MillerColumnsResizeHandlePropsResizeHandle}. Optional: a
childless branch legitimately opens an empty column, which carries
`data-empty` for the styling layer.

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-column
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

props.name: children
props.description:
The cell content and, for a branch item, a single nested
`<MillerColumns.Column>` (split out by `partitionItemChildren`).

props.name: value
props.description:
Stable identifier used to match this item against the selection path.
The item is selected when the path entry at its depth equals `value`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the cell as a single consumer-supplied child element (e.g. an
`<a>`) instead of the default `<div>`, merging the treeitem ARIA,
handlers, and ref onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern. Any nested
`<MillerColumns.Column>` remains a sibling of the cell element.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
When `true`, the item renders `aria-disabled` / `data-disabled` and is
skipped by roving navigation — it cannot be selected, focused, or
activated.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Forwarded to the rendered element. Defaults to `HTMLDivElement`; when
using `asChild`, specify the child's element type. Composed with the
library's internal ref.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description:
Largest width the column can be dragged or stepped to, in pixels.
Published as `aria-valuemax` when finite; left unbounded by default,
in which case the attribute is omitted.

props.name: minWidth
props.description:
Smallest width the column can be dragged or stepped to, in pixels.
Also published as `aria-valuemin`.

dataAttributes.name: data-miller-columns-resize-handle
dataAttributes.when: always — a structural hook the component's own CSS uses to find this part, and yours may too

dataAttributes.name: data-dragging
dataAttributes.when: a pointer drag is in progress

props.name: children
props.description:
The preview content for the current selection (typically driven by
{@link useMillerColumnsSelection }).

props.name: forceMount
props.description:
Keep the panel mounted regardless of the selection, instead of following
Finder's rule (a preview only where a selected *leaf* would open a child
column). Use it for a persistent inspector, or to animate the panel in
and out.

api.description:
`<primitiv-miller-columns>` — the strip of a Miller Columns view, and the state owner: a row of vertical lists where selecting a branch reveals its children in the next column.

**Columns are written as siblings, not nested.** Each column after the first names the item it lists the children of with `parent`; the root shows the root column (the one without a `parent`) and, for each value on the path, the column naming it, and sets `hidden` on every other. An item is a branch while some column names it. So a server can render the whole tree, or only the open columns, or send a column when its branch is selected (`primitiv-miller-columns-show`), and the root never moves a node it did not write.

**To load a branch lazily, render its column empty.** An item is a branch only while a column names it, so a branch whose children are fetched later still needs `<primitiv-miller-columns-column parent="…"></primitiv-miller-columns-column>` in the markup up front; without it the item reads as a leaf and never opens. Listen for `primitiv-miller-columns-show` on the strip, and when it comes from an empty column, fetch and append its items.

The strip scrolls to its inline end when a column opens (not on first render). Resize handles keep each depth's width, so a column opened at a resized depth takes that width, as React's do.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The active path: the selected item's value in each column, from the root, space-separated. Reflected: it moves as the user selects, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live path.

events.name: primitiv-miller-columns-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user's selection applies, with the path afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to keep the current path.

api.description: `<primitiv-miller-columns-tree>` — the `role="tree"` widget inside the strip, holding only the columns. Structural: the root writes its role. Name it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. A tree may own only items and groups, so the preview panel sits beside it, not in it.
`<primitiv-miller-columns-column>` — one column, a `role="group"` of items. Structural: the root writes its ARIA and `hidden` while it is off the path.

attributes.name: parent
attributes.description: The value of the item whose children this column lists. Leave it off the root column.

events.name: primitiv-miller-columns-show
events.description: Bubbles from the column as it opens (not on first render), so a lazy column can fetch its items.

api.description: `<primitiv-miller-columns-item>` — one item, a `role="treeitem"`: a branch while some column names it as `parent`, a leaf otherwise. Structural: the root writes its ARIA. Its text is what typeahead matches.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The item's value, unique among its column's items; the path holds it and a child column names it.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Keeps the item focusable for discovery, but never selectable.

api.description: `<primitiv-miller-columns-item-indicator>` — a decorative `aria-hidden` glyph in an item, shown only while that item is a branch.

`<primitiv-miller-columns-resize-handle>` — a focusable WAI-ARIA window splitter in a column: drag it, or press the arrows, Home or End, to set the width of the column at its depth. Give it an accessible name.

attributes.name: min-width
attributes.description: The narrowest width, published as `aria-valuemin`. Defaults to `0`.

attributes.name: max-width
attributes.description: The widest width, published as `aria-valuemax`. Unbounded by default.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Pixels per arrow press. Defaults to `10`.

api.description: `<primitiv-miller-columns-preview-panel>` — the trailing preview pane, beside the tree. It shows only while the deepest selected item is a leaf; what it shows is yours, from `primitiv-miller-columns-change`.

attributes.name: force-mount
attributes.description: Keep the panel shown whatever is selected; `data-empty` marks it while nothing is.
